# asc_role (Data Source)

Reads a role and its associated permissions from the authorization service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role to look up.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) The list of permission actions assigned to this role.
